description: This file defines API route handlers for project management in a FastAPI application, including endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting projects, with appropriate access control and auditing.

methods.name: list_projects(user: UserProfile = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all projects accessible to authenticated users.

methods.name: create_project(payload: ProjectCreate, user: UserProfile = Depends(require_role("manager")))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new project, requiring 'manager' or 'admin' role.

methods.name: get_project(project_id: UUID, user: UserProfile = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific project by its UUID.

methods.name: update_project(project_id: UUID, payload: ProjectUpdate, user: UserProfile = Depends(require_role("manager")))
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing project's details, requiring 'manager' or 'admin' role.

methods.name: delete_project(project_id: UUID, user: UserProfile = Depends(require_role("manager")))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a project, requiring 'admin' or 'manager' role.

ctags.name: update_project
ctags.pattern: /^def update_project(project_id: UUID, payload: ProjectUpdate, user: UserProfile = Depends(require/
ctags.signature: (project_id: UUID, payload: ProjectUpdate, user: UserProfile = Depends(require_role("manager")))
